messages.content:
Rewrite these unverified audio-model observations into non-speech captions
for Deaf/hard-of-hearing viewers. These observations are the ONLY factual input;
do not add sounds, source identities, emotion, visuals, plot or interpretations.
Do not treat observations as independently verified. Remove speculative causes
or moods. Preserve multiple audible sound types. Three texts per observation:
essential (short labels), balanced (brief description), detailed (more of the
already supplied acoustic detail, at most 25 words). All <= 278 characters, no
brackets, markup or newlines. If the observation explicitly reports no non-speech
sounds, return null texts for that id. Return only a JSON object with key captions,
an array of objects with EXACT keys id, essential, balanced, detailed. Preserve
every input id exactly once. Do not generate timestamps. Observations:
[{"id": "165", "observation": "A siren sounds, followed by a door opening, a person walking, and a door closing."}, {"id": "180", "observation": "A lively jazz ensemble plays, followed by a solo clarinet melody, with intermittent mechanical sounds and a brief electronic tone."}, {"id": "195", "observation": "A piano plays a slow, melancholic melody, accompanied by a soft, rhythmic heartbeat and a faint, high-pitched electronic tone."}, {"id": "225", "observation": "A gentle, melodic piano piece plays softly, accompanied by faint, intermittent bird chirps in the background."}, {"id": "240", "observation": "A dramatic orchestral score with sweeping strings, powerful brass, and resonant percussion builds tension and intensity throughout the clip."}, {"id": "270", "observation": "A dramatic orchestral piece featuring strings, brass, and percussion, with a prominent, sustained high-pitched string note."}, {"id": "285", "observation": "A dramatic orchestral fanfare with brass, strings, and percussion, featuring a powerful crescendo and a sharp, high-pitched metallic impact."}, {"id": "300", "observation": "A sharp metallic impact and rapid mechanical clicks are followed by a sustained, high-pitched electronic tone."}]
